asked: # Build: axhub-pass-all (axHub repo) Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice), correcting the pass that was just built on branch claude/axhub-veto-pass: "It's not supposed to be 30 minutes for theme changes. It's 30 minutes to do whatever I tell you." ## Change - Add a scope `all` (the default when no scope is given) to timed passes: while an `all` pass is active, EVERY held call on EVERY service (vps.run, vps.logs, memory writes/deletes, github, amberx, console/token-control, anything added later) runs immediately with no veto/confirm hold. Existing narrower scopes stay available. - Spoken grant phrasing the tool must handle cleanly: `axhub.pass_grant {minutes: 30}` = all, 30 min; `{scope: 'tokens.theme', minutes: 30}` = narrow. - Keep exactly one guard, and say it in the tool description: calls the connector marks `irreversible` (deleting a GitHub repo, wiping a database/volume, deleting the vault, dropping a Coolify app's data) still ask, unless the grant says `include_irreversible: true` (Brett can say "including deletes"). Ordinary deletes (a note, a file, a branch, a container) ARE covered by `all`. - The grant itself still needs Brett once (owner approval or axHub web); an agent can never grant itself a pass. Unchanged. - Banner/countdown and the 'ran under pass' log already exist: show the scope ('everything') there. - Tests (all covers every service; irreversible guard; include_irreversible; narrow scopes unchanged), docs, decision log entry. - When done, push your commits onto `claude/axhub-veto-pass` too (fast-forward; your branch is based on it) so the landing job lands the complete version, and note it in the PR. Commits clean and professional. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.
